chapter_title_en: Disturbance Overseas, a Retreat in Fear
chapter_seo_title: Han Li Deploys Puppets to Scare Off Foundation Establishment Cultivators
chapter_meta_description: A celestial omen draws Foundation Establishment cultivators to Han Li’s island. He deploys high-grade puppets and an ultimatum, forcing a tactical retreat. The real storm is yet to come.
og_title: Han Li’s Territorial Claim: A Study in Intelligent Deterrence
og_description: Foundation Establishment cultivators arrive at a strange island only to find a cold voice and a line of high-grade puppets waiting for them. Another masterclass in Mortal Stream survival.
twitter_title: Han Li vs. the Treasure Hunters
twitter_description: Three cultivators chase a treasure, but a line of high-grade puppets meets them. In the Mortal Stream, a credible threat is often better than a fight.

lore_anchors.definition: A visible phenomenon in the sky often associated with the birth of a great treasure or a change in the world’s energy.
A Foundation Establishment cultivator of the Tai Yang Sect; serves as a cautious, bureaucratic foil to the more aggressive treasure seekers.
A cultivation sect; Han Li knows its sect leader by name, establishing it as a minor power with some connections.
A powerful artificial construct capable of combat; deploying multiple at once is a major show of wealth and force.
